question: Can you identify my little blue pill and tell me if it is okay during pregnancy?
fullAnswer:
I cannot identify a medicine from its appearance or a vague description. Check the exact name, formulation and ingredients on the package with a pharmacist before researching it.

Informational only; not medical advice. Patients should talk to a clinician, pharmacist or poison control before starting, stopping or changing any medication.
